notes.title: Patch Notes 20250517
notes.content:
Dear players

Hello, this is Takayakata, the developer.

Thank you very much for purchasing/playing Aden.

Aden was updated on May 17, 2025.

The changes include the following bug fixes.

-Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when Steam Input was enabled
-Fixed several text errors
-Fixed to prioritize loading gamepads when multiple devices are connected

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: What to do if the game quits /controller does not respond
notes.content:
※Machine translation.

Dear Players

Hello, I am Takayakata, the developer of Aden.

Thank you very much for purchasing/playing Aden.

We are sorry for the following problem, but we are not able to fix it because we do not know the cause.

[h3]- Sometimes the game crashes before transitioning to the title screen after startup[/h3] 
→This happens when steam input is enabled.

[h1][b]Please disable STEAM input[/b][/h1].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43145083/aec7c105c9a35c9fa6443d755b6b36d43c4126c1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43145083/a1cc01fd8da4e87706a2f7ebba66c8fadc16d4ef.jpg[/img]


In addition to the above problems, the following problems may also occur 
[h3]- Controller input may not respond[/h3] 
In this case, it may be due to multiple controllers being connected to the PC.
In the sub-den, only one controller input can be recognized.
[b]The problem may be resolved by reducing the number of controllers connected to the PC to one[/b] 
Also, a device other than the controller may be recognized as a controller on the PC side, causing the problem. Please check the controller connection and device settings on your PC.

We are very sorry for the trouble you are experiencing.
We hope that many people can enjoy Aden.
Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Aiden_1214 patch notes
notes.content:
Please note that machine translations are used.

Dear Players

Hello, I am Takayakata, the developer of Aden.

Thank you so much for purchasing/playing Aden.

We are very sorry for the problem that you cannot play under certain circumstances/environments,

We have received the following information


[h3]When a controller is left connected, the game sometimes crashes before transitioning to the title screen after startup[/h3]
→I was able to reproduce this issue. It seems to occur when a controller is connected and steam input is enabled.
→We do not have a clear fix for this issue and it will take some time to fix it.
We apologize for the inconvenience, [b][u][h1]please disable steam input and start the game. [/h1][/u][/b]

[h3]Sometimes the game does not start at all even if the start button is pressed[/h3]
→We have not been able to reproduce the problem and do not know the cause... We have received information that the problem did not occur in the demo version, so we have taken action to downgrade the versions of some plug-ins to the same versions as in the demo, but we have not been able to confirm that this has been corrected. We are sorry, but we will continue to investigate. We apologize for the inconvenience, but we will continue to investigate.

The update was made on December 14. Details are below.
/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
The versions of plug-ins that were potentially unstable have been downgraded to the versions that were stable at the time of the Aden demo version.

Fixed a bug that caused counter attacks to occur constantly.

Fixed a bug that caused the map icon to disappear when returning to the map at a certain timing, making it impossible to progress.

Fixed a bug that some objects remained when retrying at a certain timing.

Fixed some typos.
/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////


That's all.
We are really sorry for the problems that prevented you from playing in certain situations/environments.
We apologize for not being able to respond to many of your messages individually.
It may take some time to respond to all of them, or at worst we may not be able to fix it... but I personally absolutely want you to be able to play and will continue to investigate as much as possible. Again, thank you so much for purchasing/playing the Aden! We look forward to working with you in the future!

notes.title: Forced termination bug when starting with a controller plugged in
notes.content:
There seems to be a bug that causes force close when certain types of controllers are plugged in.
This is currently under investigation. We are very sorry for the inconvenience. Thank you very much.

notes.title: ADEN　PLAY　DEMO
notes.content:
Introducing the dance belt scrolling game Aden.

Aden is a system game that is a development of belt scrolling games.
Collision → Dodge → Blast → Dance!
The basic attack method is ramming!
The main feature of this work is the simple and lightly rebuilt belt-scrolling boss battle.
If you reduce your physical strength enough, you will be able to dance with the boss, and you will enter a rhythm QTE where you dance to the BGM!
By completing the dance until the end, your opponent will explode!
Fight as if you were dancing, and actually dance to defeat them!

notes.title: ADEN STEAM NEXTFes
notes.content:
Introducing the dancing belt-scrolling game Aden!

Aden is a game with a belt-scrolling game system that has evolved
Bumping, dodging, flipping, and dancing!
The basic attack method is body slamming!
The most distinctive feature of this game is the simple and lightly reconstructed belt scroll boss battle!
When you bump into a boss and reduce its health enough, you can dance with it and enter a rhythm QTE in which you dance to the BGM!
By deciding to dance to the end, the opponent explodes!
Fight like you dance and beat them by actually dancing!
